hypothesis: Instruction count is dominated by per-tile decoder overhead and tile-area-dependent computation, with different costs for initial and subsequent latent frames.

pcvs.name: tiles
pcvs.rationale: Counts spatial tiles, each requiring cache setup and an initial decoder call.

pcvs.name: cached_tile_frames
pcvs.rationale: Counts subsequent decoder calls, which activate temporal upsampling and populated-cache paths.

pcvs.expression: z.shape[0] * (z.shape[3] + (z.shape[3] - 1) // (self.tile_sample_stride_height // self.spatial_compression_ratio) * ((self.tile_sample_min_height - self.tile_sample_stride_height) // self.spatial_compression_ratio)) * (z.shape[4] + (z.shape[4] - 1) // (self.tile_sample_stride_width // self.spatial_compression_ratio) * ((self.tile_sample_min_width - self.tile_sample_stride_width) // self.spatial_compression_ratio))
pcvs.name: initial_tile_area
pcvs.rationale: For the fixed workload, computes total latent tile area including overlaps and clipped boundary tiles; models spatial computation on initial frames.

pcvs.expression: z.shape[0] * (z.shape[2] - 1) * (z.shape[3] + (z.shape[3] - 1) // (self.tile_sample_stride_height // self.spatial_compression_ratio) * ((self.tile_sample_min_height - self.tile_sample_stride_height) // self.spatial_compression_ratio)) * (z.shape[4] + (z.shape[4] - 1) // (self.tile_sample_stride_width // self.spatial_compression_ratio) * ((self.tile_sample_min_width - self.tile_sample_stride_width) // self.spatial_compression_ratio))
pcvs.name: cached_tile_area
pcvs.rationale: Models spatial computation for subsequent frames, whose temporal expansion increases convolution, normalization, and copying work.
